title: When Verification Is Not Agreement: Cross-Agent LLM-to-Dafny Formalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.07073v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A verified Dafny postcondition certifies that a formula holds, but it does not guarantee that the result was reached through genuine independent reasoning. We introduce a cross-agent formalization protocol where a Specifier model translates clinical trial criteria into a Dafny predicate, and an Implementer model writes an operational method checked against it. A same-model control establishes that even with no capability gap, independent re-extraction from identical text agrees only 59.3% of the time. Evaluating four model configurations on 96 clinical trial documents, we find that agreement is highly sensitive to how model capability is allocated across the two roles: the GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini configuration achieves 53.0% agreement when the stronger model is the Implementer, but only 14.3% when the roles are reversed. translated_title: 当验证不等于一致：跨智能体LLM到Dafny的形式化
translated_abstract: 经过验证的Dafny后置条件只能证明一个公式成立，但并不能保证该结果是通过真正的独立推理得出的。我们提出了一种跨智能体形式化协议：由“规约者”模型将临床试验标准翻译为Dafny谓词，再由“实现者”模型编写一个依据该谓词进行验证的操作性方法。同模型对照实验表明，即使两个模型之间不存在能力差距，从相同文本独立重新提取时的一致率也仅为59.3%。在96份临床试验文档上对四种模型配置进行评估后，我们发现一致性高度依赖于模型能力在两个角色之间的分配方式：GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini配置在较强模型担任实现者时达到53.0%的一致率，而当角色互换时仅为14.3%。测试中最强的配置GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini将一致率提升至34.4%，但仍低于同模型对照基线（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出跨智能体Dafny形式化协议，证明验证通过并不等于真正独立的推理一致，且一致率对模型能力在规约者与实现者两个角色间的分配极为敏感（较强模型担任实现者时为53.0%，角色互换后骤降至14.3%）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a cross-agent LLM-to-Dafny formalization protocol, showing that verification does not guarantee genuine independent agreement, and that agreement is highly sensitive to how model capability is allocated between the Specifier and Implementer roles (53.0% with the stronger model as Implementer vs. only 14.3% when reversed).
